meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 你把本地附件的路径发来，它在容器内用 anydoc 把 Word、演示文稿、表格、PDF 等文件转成一份 Markdown 文件，并把转换后的路径告诉你。
howto.when: 当你发来的消息里带有本地附件路径，并且需要不把它上传到外部解析器、直接在本地读取时，它会接管。

say.text: 这份 CSV 从 stdin 读，格式指定为 csv
say.note: 按 --format csv 从标准输入转换

say.text: 转换失败了，告诉我具体原因
say.note: 会说明不支持、加密或资源限制等原因

howto.what_en: Give it a local attachment path and it uses anydoc inside the agent container to convert Word, presentation, spreadsheet, PDF and similar files into a Markdown file, then reports the converted path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

say_en.text: Convert this file path to Markdown: /workspace/inbox/msg/report.docx
say_en.note: Converts locally and returns the .md path

say_en.text: Read the CSV from stdin, with the format set to csv
The conversion failed — tell me exactly why
say_en.note: Reports unsupported, encrypted, or limit errors
